question: In the fabrication of a solar cell, the top p-type layer is made extremely thin compared to the bottom n-type layer. What is the specific purpose of this geometry?

options.A: To increase the resistance of the cell.
options.B: To allow light to penetrate easily to the junction.
options.C: To reduce the cost of p-type material.
options.D: To prevent the cell from heating up.
